notes: Added API/UI and integration coverage for consent framework.

change_log.note: Add API layer for consent capture and retrieval
Ensure consent framework integrates with lead capture service

SHARED-F-2-S133.title: Consent API Endpoints
SHARED-F-2-S133.description: Expose FastAPI endpoints for capturing consent decisions, retrieving consent status, and updating consent tier, ensuring alignment with tool_router and application facade patterns.

SHARED-F-2-S134.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture
SHARED-F-2-S134.description: Integrate consent framework with lead_service to enforce Tier 2 requirements for identifiable lead creation and ensure Tier 1 flows remain anonymized.

SHARED-F-2-S135.title: Consent Audit Logging
SHARED-F-2-S135.description: Implement audit logging for all consent decisions, including tier selection, timestamp, and data handling actions, ensuring traceability for compliance and debugging.

SHARED-F-2.mitigation: Strict enforcement of consent_service gating and audit logging using existing infrastructure without expanding scope.
